title.zh: 在马斯巴特省Milagros市镇设立、组建并维持一所国立农业学校并授权为此拨付特定款项的法案
title.en: An Act to Establish, Organize and Maintain One National Agricultural School in the Municipality of Milagros, Province of Masbate and to Authorize the Appropriation of Certain Sums of Money for the Purpose
title.orig: An Act to Establish, Organize and Maintain One National Agricultural School in the Municipality of Milagros, Province of Masbate and to Authorize the Appropriation of Certain Sums of Money for the Purpose

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1951/ra_605_1951.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Secretary of Education is hereby authorized to establish, organize and maintain one National Agricultural School in the municipality of Milagros, Province of Masbate of the Central Luzon Agricultural School type, to be called the Masbate Agricultural School.

The sum of one hundred thousand pesos for its establishment and operation and maintenance during its first year, and such adequate sums as may be needed in subsequent years for its operation and maintenance yearly thereafter, are hereby authorized to be appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated.

The Secretary of Education is hereby empowered to locate and acquire or cause to be located and acquired a suitable site for the purpose of this Act, which may be public or private lands situated within the municipality of Milagros, Province of Masbate.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, April 27, 1951.
